is_anopheles.evidence: The paper discusses malaria vectors in sub-Saharan Africa including Anopheles gambiae, An. funestus, and An. arabiensis in the context of spatial repellent modeling (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped in this study; Vgsc mutations are mentioned only in passing via literature citation (page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper contains no mosquito genotyping assays or extractable genotype data.

african_field_population.evidence: No primary mosquito collections or field populations were sampled and tested in this paper.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a review, roadmap perspective, and epidemiological transmission/economic modeling study.

sub_country_location.evidence: No specific mosquito field collection sites are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No primary field collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: No primary genotype dataset is reported.

supplement.evidence: The supplementary file S1 contains product descriptions, not mosquito genotype data.

assessment.summary: This article describes a roadmap and disease transmission/economic modeling framework for evaluating spatial repellents for malaria and dengue control under the AEGIS program. It does not generate or report any primary empirical mosquito genotyping or bioassay data.
